actions.description: Check if a mailbox can be provisioned. Determines whether a mailbox can be provisioned for the given email address and which entitlements are available to use.

x_request_id.description: Optional client-generated request correlation identifier. Propagated across services and echoed in the X-Request-Id response header.

actions.name: email_create_mailbox
actions.description: Create a new email mailbox. Provisions a new email mailbox for a domain owned by the authenticated account. Returns 202 Accepted with the mailbox in its initial state (status: EXECUTING). Poll GET /mailboxes/{mailboxId} until status reaches COMPLETED or FAILED. Example body: { "emailAddress": "jane.smith@example.com", "accountId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", "firstName": "Jane", "lastName": "Smith", "consents": [ { "type": "FREETRIAL_AUTORENEW" } ] }

x_request_id.description: Optional client-generated request correlation identifier. Propagated across services and echoed in the X-Request-Id response header.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated unique key (UUID recommended). Retrying a POST request with the same Idempotency-Key returns the original response without creating a duplicate mailbox.

emailAddress.description: The full email address for the new mailbox.

accountId.description: Entitlement identifier selecting which eligible account/plan to provision the mailbox against (matches EligibleAccount.accountId).

firstName.description: First name associated with the mailbox.

lastName.description: Last name associated with the mailbox.

consents.description: Consent agreements to fulfill at creation time. Required when the selected eligible account has requirements. Each entry must include a type matching a requirement from EligibleAccount.requirements[].type. [type (required): string — Requirement type code being consented to.]

actions.name: email_list_mailboxes
actions.description: List all email mailboxes. Returns a paged list of email mailboxes for domains owned by the authenticated account, across all supported email platforms.

pageSize.description: Number of mailboxes per page. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

field.description: Comma-separated list of top-level Mailbox fields to include in each response object. When omitted, all fields are returned.

totalRequired.description: When true, includes totalItems and totalPages in the response body and adds a last navigation link.

x_request_id.description: Optional client-generated request correlation identifier. Propagated across services and echoed in the X-Request-Id response header.

actions.name: email_get_mailbox
actions.description: Get a single mailbox by ID. Returns the current state of a single mailbox. Poll this endpoint after POST /mailboxes until status reaches COMPLETED or FAILED.

mailboxId.description: The mailbox identifier returned from POST /mailboxes.

x_request_id.description: Optional client-generated request correlation identifier. Propagated across services and echoed in the X-Request-Id response header.

actions.name: shopping_search_catalog
actions.description: Search the catalog. Search available catalog products by free-text query or filters. The request body is optional; an empty request returns the available catalog. Results use cursor pagination.

request_id.description: For tracing the request across network layers and components.

actions.name: shopping_lookup_catalog
actions.description: Look up products by ID. Retrieve products or variants by known ID. Each returned variant includes `inputs[]` that identifies the requested ID it matched. Unresolved IDs are returned as informational messages instead of a not-found response. Use catalog search for product discovery.

request_id.description: For tracing the request across network layers and components.

actions.name: shopping_get_product
actions.description: Get product details. Retrieve details for one product by ID. The current catalog does not support option selection or preference-based narrowing; send only `id`. Use catalog search to discover products.

request_id.description: For tracing the request across network layers and components.

actions.name: shopping_create_checkout
actions.description: Create a checkout session for the authenticated customer. Provide at least one selected product in `line_items[]`. Buyer contact details, context, and payment selection are optional. The response is `incomplete` until it has purchasable line items and a selected eligible saved payment instrument. For POS and hardware products, use `input` with a `commerce_location` type and the required business and store IDs.

request_id.description: For tracing the request across network layers and components.

idempotency_key.description: Ensures duplicate operations don't happen during retries.

actions.name: shopping_get_checkout
actions.description: Get a checkout session. Retrieve the current checkout session state, including line items, totals, selected payment instruments, messages, and required agreements.

id.description: The unique identifier of the checkout session.

request_id.description: For tracing the request across network layers and components.

actions.name: shopping_update_checkout
actions.description: Update a checkout session. Replace the writable checkout session state. Send the full `line_items[]` collection on every request. Omitted writable values are cleared, and server-generated fields are ignored. For POS and hardware products, retain the `commerce_location` input. If a submitted product cannot be priced, the response excludes it and includes a `line_item_removed` warning.

id.description: The unique identifier of the checkout session.

request_id.description: For tracing the request across network layers and components.

idempotency_key.description: Ensures duplicate operations don't happen during retries.

actions.name: shopping_complete_checkout
actions.description: Complete a checkout session. Complete a ready checkout session and create its order. `payment` is required. The successful response includes an order ID and receipt URL; use `GET /orders/{id}` to retrieve full order details. If the checkout response includes `required_agreements`, include each required key in `consent.agreement_types` with its acceptance timestamp. Missing or incomplete consent returns a `400` validation error.

id.description: The unique identifier of the checkout session.

request_id.description: For tracing the request across network layers and components.

idempotency_key.description: Ensures duplicate operations don't happen during retries.

actions.name: shopping_get_order
actions.description: Get order. Retrieve an order created by a completed checkout session. The response includes line items, totals, fulfillment details, and a receipt URL.

request_id.description: For tracing the request across network layers and components.

actions.name: ans_register_agent
actions.description: Register a new agent with the ANS. Registers a new agent with the Agent Name Service. Supports GoDaddy domains (synchronous, CSR-based), external domains (async ACME), and bring-your-own-certificate (BYOC, server certificates only). Returns 202 with registration status and any validation requirements.

actions.name: ans_get_agent
actions.description: Retrieve agent details. Retrieves detailed information about a registered agent

actions.name: ans_search_ans_name
actions.description: Search the ANSName Registry with flexible criteria. Searches the Agent Name Service registry using flexible criteria such as partial agent names, agent host domains, and version ranges. The search can return multiple matching agents along with their metadata and endpoints. Results are paginated to handle large datasets efficiently.

protocol.description: Target protocol (optional filter) - valid values are 'A2A', 'MCP', 'HTTP-API'

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 20, max 100)

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0)

status.description: Filter by agent lifecycle status. Can specify multiple values. Defaults to ACTIVE when not provided. Use 'ALL' to return agents of any status. If 'ALL' is included with other status values, only 'ALL' is applied.

actions.name: ans_resolve_ans_name
actions.description: Resolve an ANSName to an endpoint. Resolves an ANSName to an actionable endpoint reference. The query includes the ANSName of the target agent and can optionally incorporate capability filters to refine the search. The ANS service queries the Agent Registry, which returns a digitally signed endpoint record if found.

actions.name: ans_revoke_agent
actions.description: Revoke an active agent or cancel a pending registration. Revokes an active agent or cancels a pending registration. Active agents are added to the Certificate Revocation List. Registrations in PENDING_VALIDATION status cannot be cancelled through this endpoint and expire automatically.

actions.name: ans_get_agent_events
actions.description: Retrieve ANS agent events. Returns a paginated, strictly ordered list of ANS events. When providerId is omitted, the API returns events for all providers; when providerId is provided, only events associated with that provider are returned. Pagination is driven by an opaque cursor token returned in each response.

providerId.description: Optional provider identifier. If omitted, global mode is used and the API returns events for all providers from the primary global stream. When provided, results are filtered to only events associated with that provider.

lastLogId.description: Optional log id for the last viewed event from a previous request. If not provided, the API returns the first page of results from the start of the event stream. Events are only stored for 30 days.

limit.description: Number of events to return (1-200, default 100)

x_request_id.description: Unique identifier for request tracking between services (UUID V1 as Base58)

actions.name: ans_validate_registration
actions.description: Trigger ACME validation. Initiates domain control validation after the ACME challenge token has been placed at the specified location. The RA determines the validation method automatically based on the registration configuration.

actions.name: ans_verify_dns_records
actions.description: Verify DNS record configuration. Verifies that all required DNS records have been configured correctly. The RA knows which records are required based on the registration and will check for all four required records (HTTPS, TLSA, _ans, _ra-badge). This is the final step for external domain registration.

actions.name: ans_get_agent_csr_status_by_agent_id
actions.description: Get CSR status. Retrieves the current status of a Certificate Signing Request (CSR). This endpoint allows clients to check if a CSR has been signed, is still pending, or has been rejected. The failureReason field provides additional context when a CSR is rejected.

agentId.description: Unique identifier of the agent (UUID format)

actions.name: ans_submit_agent_identity_csr_by_agent_id
actions.description: Submit identity certificate CSR. Submits a Certificate Signing Request (CSR) for the agent's identity certificate. The response contains a "csrId", that is going to match the same field from CertificateResponse.

agentId.description: Unique identifier of the agent (UUID format)

actions.name: ans_get_agent_identity_certificate_by_agent_id
actions.description: Retrieve agent identity certificates. Retrieves all identity certificates for the specified agent

agentId.description: Unique identifier of the agent (UUID format)

actions.name: ans_get_agent_server_certificate_by_agent_id
actions.description: Retrieve agent server certificates. Retrieves all TLS server certificates for the specified agent

agentId.description: Unique identifier of the agent (UUID format)

actions.name: ans_submit_server_certificate_renewal
actions.description: Submit server certificate renewal request. Initiates server certificate renewal. Returns ACME challenges that the caller must verify using POST verify-acme. Supports a CSR path (RA issues the certificate) and a BYOC path (caller provides the certificate). Only one pending renewal is allowed per agent; 409 if one already exists.

agentId.description: Unique identifier of the agent (UUID format)

body.description: Renewal request (CSR or BYOC) Full shape: https://developer.godaddy.com/docs/references/rest/ans/submit-server-certificate-renewal

actions.name: ans_get_server_certificate_renewal_status
actions.description: Retrieve pending renewal status. Returns current server certificate renewal status for the agent, if one exists. Use to check ACME verification progress, poll for certificate issuance, retrieve challenges if the POST response was lost, or get the TLSA record after completion.

agentId.description: Unique identifier of the agent (UUID format)

actions.name: ans_cancel_server_certificate_renewal
actions.description: Cancel pending renewal. Cancels the pending server certificate renewal for this agent. Use when the submitted CSR was incorrect, to switch between CSR and BYOC paths, or to abandon the renewal. Removes the pending renewal and marks any associated CSR as REJECTED.

agentId.description: Unique identifier of the agent (UUID format)

actions.name: ans_verify_acme_challenges
actions.description: Verify ACME challenges for pending server cert renewal. Triggers ACME validation for a pending server certificate renewal. Verifies the DNS-01 (TXT record) and HTTP-01 (file at /.well-known/acme-challenge) challenges. Returns 202 for CSR renewals (async issuance) or 200 for BYOC renewals (certificate stored).

agentId.description: Unique identifier of the agent (UUID format)

actions.name: ans_list_registered_agents
actions.description: List registered agents. Lists registered agents using query parameters. Returns a ranked collection; follow pagination links[].href for subsequent pages. Anonymous requests are accepted when the Authorization header is omitted and are rate limited to 60 requests per minute per client IP.

query.description: Optional search query string. If omitted and no filters are provided, the API returns all agents except `REVOKED` by default. When `statuses` is explicitly provided, the API uses only the provided status values. Max length is 256 characters by default. When `keywordExtraction=true`, max length is 4096 characters.

keywordExtraction.description: When true, extracts keywords from the query text before searching. Increases max query length from 256 to 4096 characters. Requires `query` to be non-empty.

keywordAlgorithm.description: Keyword extraction algorithm to use when `keywordExtraction=true`.

pageToken.description: Opaque token from a previous response `links[].href` relation (`rel=next` or `rel=prev`).

pageTokenDirection.description: Optional token direction when `pageToken` is set. Only valid when `pageToken` is provided. Requests that send `pageTokenDirection` without `pageToken` return `422 INVALID_REQUEST`.

totalRequired.description: When true, include `totalItems` and `totalPages` in the response envelope.

statuses.description: Filter by lifecycle statuses. When omitted, default behavior excludes `REVOKED`.

agentDomains.description: Agent host domain-family filters. Each value matches apex plus subdomains.

x_request_id.description: Optional request identifier propagated across services.

actions.name: ans_get_registered_agent
actions.description: Retrieve agent details. Returns a single registered agent with trust explainability details. Search-only ranking scores are not included. Anonymous requests are accepted when the Authorization header is omitted and are rate limited to 60 requests per minute per client IP.

x_request_id.description: Optional request identifier propagated across services.

actions.name: ans_search_registered_agents
actions.description: Search registered agents. Searches registered agents using request-body criteria and returns ranked results. Anonymous requests are accepted when the Authorization header is omitted and are rate limited to 60 requests per minute per client IP.

x_request_id.description: Optional request identifier propagated across services.
